# Noobot v4.4.0

This release converges session, execution log, and tool protocols onto single
sources of truth, renames the web search tool, adds prompt cache TTL selection,
introduces an isolated Docker E2E environment, and fixes Windows subprocess
crashes.

## Session and execution logs

- Store execution logs per turn; the session index lists turns only.
- Make `parentSessionId` the single source of session tree facts; legacy trees
  are rebuilt by session-repair.
- Upgrade session storage through workspace layout facts and reject legacy
  execution event indexes.
- Restore sessions from explicit routes and converge reconnect replay identity.
- Separate snapshot reads from turn recovery and add a no-final-response retry
  protocol.

## Protocols and configuration

- Rename the `web_search` tool to `do_search_web` (config key
  `tools.do_search_web`) so it no longer clashes with the model's built-in
  `web_search` capability. Search results converge to `{ rawText, sources }`.
- Bind tools from the explicit model spec and read `base_url` only.
- Require an explicit global config, workspace users, and web search model.
- Make `task_check` and `task_summary` non-configurable control tools and
  remove dead config keys and aliases. Existing configs are cleaned by repair
  on startup.
- Converge the execution report protocol across routes and views.
- Audit model request logs by `X-Model-Operation`.

## Models

- Add prompt cache TTL selection.

## Testing

- Add an isolated Docker E2E environment that runs on a workspace copied from
  the host config, with suite sessions deleted after each run.

## Fixes

- Fix subprocess crashes on Windows.
- Pass the workspace root to agent-proxy on desktop and resolve session event
  identity from the channel key.
- Remove the false "system-emitted" precondition from the `task_check`
  description.
